boundary.frozen_cohort_provider: U.S. Census TIGER/Line 2025 Places and Area Hydrography
boundary.service_territory_claim: geographic benchmark domain, not observed carrier territory

legal_speed.hpms_role: secondary functional-class/legal-limit evidence, not actual running-speed observations

new_city_validation.acceptance: tests establish these two extensions; every additional city must pass its own unchanged gates
new_city_validation.applicability: historical boundary/road-gate extension tests; not a validation of the new terminal-based component pipeline
new_city_validation.scope: OSM administrative boundary and driving graph only

next_review: rebind charging and speed on the common graph; review CLE data structure and construction; independently freeze complete CLE before instance activation

road_graph.active_od_gate: directed round-trip feasibility required in Stage 2
road_graph.buffer_selection: smallest junction-node buffer covering all city public nodes recoverable at 20km; global percentage cannot trigger early stop
road_graph.directions: preserve one-way and parallel OSM edges
road_graph.osm_observation_date: record actual PBF snapshot or Overpass osm_base timestamp per build; do not substitute download time for observation year
road_graph.residual_component_policy: raw disconnected evidence retained; source-safe locations lacking directed local access are pending; no distance deletion
road_graph.terminal_graph: real OSM shared-node directed paths kept separate from through graph
road_graph.unknown_access: retain source, mark review_required, exclude from default pool

running_speed.evidence_scope: statewide commercial-vehicle prior with EPA gap filling; not measured city/edge/EDV speeds
running_speed.hour_conversion: seven-day StreetLight hourly fractions collapsed by 2023 NEI monthly VMT times StreetLight weekday fractions

temporal_policy.snapshot_policy: reuse frozen inputs; a later snapshot creates a new version
